description: This Java source file defines a custom ListFragment subclass that integrates swipe-to-refresh functionality using SwipeRefreshLayout, including a nested class to handle scroll behavior and utility methods for ListView scrolling checks.

classes.name: SwipeRefreshListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment subclass that wraps its content in a SwipeRefreshLayout to support swipe-to-refresh gestures.

classes.name: ListFragmentSwipeRefreshLayout
classes.description: A nested subclass of SwipeRefreshLayout that overrides canChildScrollUp() to enable swipe-to-refresh when the ListView can scroll up.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates the fragment's view by wrapping the ListFragment's view in a custom SwipeRefreshLayout.

methods.name: setOnRefreshListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to handle refresh gestures.

methods.name: isRefreshing
methods.description: Returns whether a refresh is currently in progress.

methods.name: setRefreshing
methods.description: Sets the refreshing state of the SwipeRefreshLayout.

methods.name: setColorScheme
methods.description: Sets the color scheme for the refresh indicator.

methods.name: getSwipeRefreshLayout
methods.description: Returns the SwipeRefreshLayout instance used in the fragment.
